cues.text: On the dorm's rooftop, Junpei kneels on the tiles, his hands still tied behind his back. Chidori stands over him.
The rooftop door bangs open and you and the others run out, Koromaru with you, and stop short at the sight of them.
Chidori turns to face you all, raises an Evoker and presses it to her head. Everyone drops into a fighting stance.
Junpei lunges from his knees and throws himself against Chidori. They crash to the ground together.
Akihiko darts over, snatches up the Evoker from beside Chidori and steps back with it. She stays on the ground.
Ikutsuki, the chairman, comes running out through the rooftop door.
Aigis walks over to Chidori and pulls her to her feet, holding her arms fast, and everyone gathers around them.
